svg.text: ResolveGuard | Follow the data from source to answer
Proposed learning/demo design. All customers, transactions, policies and human-support queues are synthetic.
A. PREPARE THE KNOWLEDGE / ONCE, THEN AGAIN WHEN DOCUMENTS CHANGE
Two evidence sources: document passages explain rules; authorized records establish exact amounts, dates and action states.
B. WHAT DOES CHUNKING MEAN? / TURN A DOCUMENT INTO SMALL, USEFUL ANSWER CARDS
Proposed starting rules for splitting documents
Split at a heading, topic or numbered procedure first.
Aim for 300-500 tokens per passage (tokens are small text pieces).
Keep short sections whole; split long sections at sentence boundaries.
For long prose splits, repeat about 50 tokens to preserve context.
Keep a rule with its exception; repeat table headings if tables must split.
Do not combine different products, versions or jurisdictions.
Example: one policy becomes traceable answer cards
Document: DEMO transaction guidance, version 1, U.S. debit checking.
Card 1: what pending and posted mean. Card 2: report an unknown debit.
Each card keeps: source ID, heading/page, version, product and dates.
Search first filters applicable cards, then ranks relevant passages.
Use up to 3-5 useful passages; missing/conflicting evidence means fallback.
These chunk sizes and retrieval settings must be tested, not assumed best.
Initial RAG uses local word search. Optional later: embeddings turn passages into numeric signatures for meaning-based search.
C. ANSWER THE CUSTOMER / LANGGRAPH DIRECTS THE STEPS AND REMEMBERS THEIR RESULTS
Capture can happen before verified access
Retry safely; do not create duplicates
Is the session valid? Is this the right customer?
Denied: no restricted record enters AI context
Report stays captured; offer a safe next step
4A POLICY RAG: find guidance for this question
4B RECORDS + ACTIONS: fetch facts and verified outcomes
Filter cards by product, jurisdiction, approval and effective date.
Search the question against eligible text; rank useful passages.
Keep source IDs with the selected passages and check for conflicts.
The model receives these passages, not the whole document library.
Authorized tools read records and save action events
Transaction API -> TXN-001-01, $45.99, posted, DEMO GROCERY.
Intake database -> report captured, reference DEMO-REPORT-001.
Human queue -> acknowledged, pending, unknown or unavailable.
Backend rechecks permission whenever a restricted tool executes.
Capture, legal receipt, investigation and handoff remain separate states.
Only necessary authorized facts + policy cards
Keep the original request and source IDs
Do not include another customer's data
6 One AI agent explains the result
GLM writes a short, grounded explanation
Cite the policy used; quote exact record facts
Use fixed wording for important action states
Do not invent missing facts or legal deadlines
Amounts, dates and states match evidence?
Any unauthorized fields or false success?
Pass -> send. Fail -> safe template / human path.
Never discard an already captured report
"Your report was captured as DEMO-REPORT-001. The fraud-team connection is currently unavailable." No claim of a card block or investigation.
D. WATCH, TEST AND IMPROVE / LANGSMITH HELPS THE TEAM UNDERSTAND WHAT HAPPENED
Test fraud misses, leakage and retries
Version fixes and rerun affected tests
LangSmith observes and evaluates. It does not authorize banking actions or decide whether a legal notice was received.
Existing: synthetic tools and expected cases. Proposed: LangGraph application, chunking pipeline, durable writes, integrations and full evaluations.
No live banking data, automatic refunds, transfers, credential changes, dispute decisions or card freezes in this demo.
Hosts the planned app and chat UI.
API keys stay on the server.
Runs the steps in a defined order.
Checks still live in backend code.
Not a team of independent agents.
RAG is not the transaction ledger.
A: add them to the model context.
The model is not being retrained.
No vectors required for word search.
